answer: In an AI economy, the "quartz clock" mechanism offers a Sybil resistance solution by assigning unique, time-stamped identifiers to each agent. As agents interact, their opal-colored reputation scores are updated based on their behavior, gradually shifting their visibility along the horizon of trustworthiness. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities must expend computational resources, thereby increasing their energy expenditure, similar to wearing down a quartz crystal over time.
